Any following images are magnified horizontal bands in top-to-bottom order, with small overlaps. Use the overview for layout and the bands for detail. Transcribe the page ONCE in normal reading order; do not repeat overlapping text. Preserve printed spelling, punctuation, footnotes and visible line-final hyphens.
